title: Unprotected echo call may raise OSError
detail: The helper _echo_aborted calls echo to write "Aborted!" to stderr. If the underlying file descriptor is closed or otherwise unavailable, echo will raise an OSError (e.g., EPIPE). This exception is not caught, so a late KeyboardInterrupt or EOF during the abort message could cause an unhandled traceback instead of the intended graceful exit.

title: Incorrect logical operator for printing blank line
detail: The original logic printed a blank line only when the console was non‑interactive **and** not running in Jupyter. The change uses `or`, causing a blank line to be printed when either condition is true, which can produce an unwanted line in interactive or Jupyter environments.
note: Says the blank line is printed when either holds, which the planted `or` does.

title: Missing await on lock acquisition
detail: Acquiring the lock returns a Deferred that must be awaited; calling it without awaiting may lead to the lock never being acquired before the item is exported, causing race conditions.
note: Names the lock acquisition that isn't awaited.

title: Incorrect lock status check
detail: The Twisted lock object exposes a method `locked()`; accessing `locked` as a property will raise an AttributeError or always evaluate to the method object, causing the condition to be wrong.

title: Incorrect accept_html logic
detail: The property is documented to return True when ``text/html`` is accepted, but the implementation returns True when it is *not* present, causing inverted behavior.
note: Says accept_html is true when text/html is absent, which the planted `not in` does.
